events.title: Constantine V defeats the Bulgarian khan Telets at Anchialus
events.description: Byzantine Emperor Constantine V defeated the Bulgarian khan Telets near Anchialus on the Black Sea coast, one of the greatest victories of his long campaigns against Bulgaria. The defeat deepened a crisis in Bulgaria, where rulers were overthrown in quick succession.

events.title: Zhu Yunwen ascends the Ming throne as the Jianwen Emperor
events.description: After the death of the Hongwu Emperor, founder of the Ming dynasty, his grandson Zhu Yunwen ascended the throne as the Jianwen Emperor. Hongwu had named him successor when his father, the heir apparent Zhu Biao, died in 1392.

events.title: The Duchy of Milan defeats the Swiss at Arbedo
events.description: The forces of the Duchy of Milan defeated those of the Swiss Confederation, the alliance of Swiss cantons, at the Battle of Arbedo.
events.html: The forces of the Duchy of Milan defeated those of the Swiss Confederation, the alliance of Swiss cantons, at the Battle of Arbedo.

events.title: Cortés flees Tenochtitlan on the Noche Triste
events.description: Under attack by the Mexica, Cortés's forces fought their way out of the city along the causeways at night, losing hundreds of Spaniards and many more Tlaxcalan allies. He returned to besiege it in 1521.

events.title: Henry II of France is mortally wounded in a joust
events.description: A splinter from the lance of the Count of Montgomery pierced the king's eye at a tournament in Paris. His death ten days later left France to weak young sons on the eve of the Wars of Religion.
events.html: A splinter from the lance of the Count of Montgomery pierced the king's eye at a tournament in Paris. His death ten days later left France to weak young sons on the eve of the Wars of Religion.

events.title: Einstein's paper on special relativity reaches the journal
events.description: Annalen der Physik received 'On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies', which showed that measurements of time and space depend on motion. E = mc² followed in a short sequel that autumn.

events.title: Tunguska explosion flattens Siberian forest
events.description: An asteroid or comet fragment exploded above the Tunguska river, levelling some 2,000 square km of forest. It is the largest impact event in recorded history.
events.html: An asteroid or comet fragment exploded above the Tunguska river, levelling some 2,000 square km of forest. It is the largest impact event in recorded history.

events.title: Hitler purges the SA in the Night of the Long Knives
events.description: SS squads killed SA chief Ernst Röhm and other rivals, including the former chancellor Kurt von Schleicher. The army welcomed the purge, and Hitler's grip on power tightened.

events.title: Britain hands Hong Kong back to China
events.description: At midnight, at a ceremony attended by the Prince of Wales and President Jiang Zemin, sovereignty passed to China after 156 years of British rule. Hong Kong became a Special Administrative Region.
